title: Globe with arcs (3D)
description: A lit Earth (world-atlas land, dark ocean, atmosphere rim) turns to a region, pins drop on the cities and great-circle arcs draw between them; city names are HTML labels that follow the pins.

title.description: Headline; wrap one word in {braces} for the italic serif accent.

cities.description: 2-6 items {name, lat, lon} in degrees (north and east positive). Cities within ~100° of each other stay on the visible side.

arcs.description: chain: 1→2→3…; hub: the first city to every other city.

focus.description: Index of the city the globe turns to; -1 = the middle of all cities.

spinFrom.description: Degrees of longitude the globe turns through before it settles.

pinStart.description: Second the first pin drops (the others follow every 0.18 s).

arcStart.description: Second the first arc starts drawing (the others follow every 0.45 s).

route.description: Line under the globe. Empty = the city names joined with arrows.

oceanColor.description: Ocean colour on the texture (keep it dark).

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47). Sets <html lang>.

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: every city label is on the visible side when it appears
no horizontal streaks on the globe texture
map data credited: Natural Earth via world-atlas
